name: source_id
description: Frost source id incl. sensor suffix, e.g. SN18700:0

name: reference_time
description: UTC time the observation refers to

name: element_id
description: Frost element id, e.g. air_temperature or mean(air_temperature P1D)

name: time_offset
description: ISO-8601 offset of the value within its time series, e.g. PT0H

name: value
description: Observed value as text; numeric for most elements, but a timestamp for unit='Date' elements (e.g. time_of_maximum_*). Use SAFE_CAST(value AS FLOAT64) for numeric elements.
